# AI Bots Creative Studio

> AI Bots Creative Studio (https://www.aibots.co.in) is a fast, private, 100% free browser-based suite of 33+ creative, financial, productivity, and gaming tools engineered by Rishit Chajjed. All processing happens locally in the browser with zero server uploads and no account requirements.

## Creative & Media Tools

- [Video Studio Pro](https://www.aibots.co.in/videoeditor.html): High-speed lossless HD video trimmer, cutter, audio extractor, and compressor.
- [Video Player & Cinema](https://www.aibots.co.in/videoplayer.html): Futuristic cyber video player with 300% audio boost, screenshot frame grabber, and playback controls.
- [Vector Logo Maker](https://www.aibots.co.in/logomaker.html): Design high-resolution vector logos, badges, and typography with instant PNG/SVG export.
- [Background Remover](https://www.aibots.co.in/backremover.html): 1-click precision background removal with client-side edge detection and transparent PNG export.
- [Precision Photo Crop](https://www.aibots.co.in/cropphoto.html): Crop photos with standard aspect ratios (1:1, 16:9, 4:3, passport, circular) and rotation.
- [Multi-Format Image Resizer](https://www.aibots.co.in/resizeimage.html): Resize images to exact pixel dimensions, percentage, or specific file sizes (KB/MB) for official forms.
- [Image Stitcher & Combiner](https://www.aibots.co.in/imagecombiner.html): Merge and combine multiple images vertically, horizontally, or in grid collages.
- [Direct Image Linker](https://www.aibots.co.in/imagelink.html): Upload and generate instant image links, Markdown codes, and HTML embed snippets.
- [Photo & Avatar Search](https://www.aibots.co.in/photogenerator.html): Search, generate, and explore royalty-free stock photos and avatar concepts.

## PDF & Financial Tools

- [Bank Statement to Tally XML](https://www.aibots.co.in/bank-statement-converter.html): Convert PDF bank statements from 21+ Indian banks (SBI, HDFC, ICICI, PNB, Axis, BOB, Canara) directly to TallyPrime / Tally.ERP 9 XML vouchers with 100% local privacy.
- [Professional Invoice Maker](https://www.aibots.co.in/invoice.html): Create professional GST/VAT invoices with automatic tax calculations, UPI QR payment codes, and print/PDF export.
- [Pro Print Studio (Ultra-HD)](https://www.aibots.co.in/print.html): High-fidelity document and image print studio with multi-page management and DPI scaling.
- [Image to PDF Maker](https://www.aibots.co.in/pdfmaker.html): Convert multiple images (JPG, PNG, WebP) into high-resolution multi-page PDF documents.
- [Fast PDF Reader & Viewer](https://www.aibots.co.in/pdfviewer.html): In-browser interactive PDF reader with text search, zoom, rotation, and multi-page viewing.
- [Live Currency Converter](https://www.aibots.co.in/currency.html): Real-time currency exchange rates for 160+ world currencies with historical trends.
- [Business Card Studio](https://www.aibots.co.in/buisnesscard.html): Design double-sided printable business cards with custom QR codes and typography.

## Utilities & AI Tools

- [Smart Emoji Studio (1120+)](https://www.aibots.co.in/emojis.html): Search 1,120+ Unicode emojis, filter by categories, customize skin tones, and 1-click copy.
- [AI Assistant (Gemini)](https://www.aibots.co.in/chatbot.html): Intelligent AI assistant powered by Gemini for coding, writing, and questions.
- [Custom QR Code Studio](https://www.aibots.co.in/qrcode.html): Generate customized QR codes for URLs, text, Wi-Fi passwords, vCards, and UPI with high-res PNG/SVG download.
- [Secure Password Generator](https://www.aibots.co.in/password.html): Cryptographically strong password generator with entropy strength analysis and presets.
- [Universal Unit Converter](https://www.aibots.co.in/unitconverter.html): Convert length, weight, temperature, speed, area, data size, volume, and time.
- [Smart Word & Text Counter](https://www.aibots.co.in/wordcounter.html): Live count of words, characters, sentences, paragraphs, and reading time estimation.
- [Live Weather Radar](https://www.aibots.co.in/weather.html): Real-time weather radar, current temperature, humidity, wind, and 5-day forecasts worldwide.
- [Precision Stopwatch & Timer](https://www.aibots.co.in/timer.html): High-precision digital stopwatch with lap recording and customizable countdown timer.
- [File Extension Changer](https://www.aibots.co.in/endchanger.html): Rename and convert file extensions safely in-browser.
- [Scientific & Standard Calculator](https://www.aibots.co.in/calculator.html): Pro scientific calculator with trigonometry (sin, cos, tan), DEG/RAD modes, logarithms, and history.

## Sports & Gaming

- [Cricket Score Counter Pro](https://www.aibots.co.in/cricketscore.html): Complete ball-by-ball cricket scorer, tournament manager, wagon wheel, extras, and scorecard download.
- [Live Match Scores Hub](https://www.aibots.co.in/cricket.html): Real-time cricket match scores, schedule, and team stats.
- [Realm of Bots: Extreme Action RPG](https://www.aibots.co.in/game.html): Open-world 2D Action RPG featuring 5 world bosses, laser katana combat, spells, mounts, pets, and quests.
- [Speed Typing Shooter Game](https://www.aibots.co.in/typingpractice.html): Fast-paced typing arcade game to test and boost WPM and typing accuracy.
